_comment: What this reference is written against. The live game's open-source code is the source of truth (owner, 2026-10-04: 'driven from the open source code'). scripts/check-updates.py compares these pins with the live game; `--pin` moves them forward after an update pass. build.py (citation links) and scripts/fetch-source.sh read them. legacy_* is the old App Engine repo the first draft was written from; it is frozen and only cited as `legacy:file.js:N`.
